items.blurb: Przemyslaw Alexander Kaminski created RACE, a Rust terminal multiplexer on an infinite canvas that detaches child shells into background processes.

items.title: Podcast: Future Cybersecurity: Hardware Memory Safety, Automated Governance and Post-Quantum Cryptography
items.blurb: In this episode, Chris Swan, engineer at Atsign and security track host at QCon London, reflects on the ideas shared during QCon London 2026 and teases topics of the future edition.

items.title: Cloudflare Fixes Cross-Tenant Data Exposure in Containers
items.blurb: Cloudflare has disclosed a cross-tenant data exposure vulnerability in Containers and Sandboxes, caused by thin-provisioned storage pools configured to skip zeroing reused blocks.

items.title: Cloudflare Plans Public Certificate Authority to Issue Quantum-Safe TLS Certificates
items.blurb: Cloudflare will operate a free public Certificate Authority to issue quantum-safe Transport Layer Security certificates. This initiative addresses challenges in migrating from classical public key cryptography to post-quantum methods.

items.title: Google's Android Security State Libraries Enable Component-Level Security Verification
items.blurb: Google's AndroidX Security State libraries enables apps to verify security patch status at the individual component level, rather than relying on a single, device-wide security patch date. By Sergio De Simone

items.title: Your Xiaomi phone may be sending you phishing notifications.
items.blurb: TLDR: the ads on Xiaomi phone can imitate icons of apps you already have installed. In my case some phishing "spotify casino" app was shown as if it was a legit notification.
